sive card grid for the DeepSeek Harness composer model picker — host-only, no client bundle rebuild.
# dsh-model-grid
Turn the composer model picker in DeepSeek Harness from a long one-per-row list into a responsive **
card grid**, grouped by provider.
| Before | After |
## Features
- **Responsive grid.** As many columns as fit the popup (`auto-fill`), never fewer than one, so it d

egrades gracefully on narrow windows.
- **Grouped by provider.** Each provider keeps its own section

; the provider heading spans the full row.
- **Works with both pickers.** The stock `dsh-client-ui-m
odel-selection` dropdown *and* the third-party `dsh-peakrate` model menu (which replaces the stock t

rigger when installed). The stylesheet does not depend on either plugin being present.
- **Configura

ble.** Width, card width, gap, height cap, and whether to hide the long price countdown.
- **Host-on
ly, upgrade-safe.** A single `<style>` is injected into the page `<head>` through the `webserver/ind

ex-inject` event. No client bundle is rebuilt, so it keeps working after DSH updates.
- **No runtime

. No client bundle is rebuilt, so it keeps working after DSH updates.
- **No runtime dependencies.**
## Supported pickers
| Picker | What identifies it | Notes |
| Stock `dsh-client-ui-model-selection` | `[data-menu-group]` sections, `[role="menuitemradio"]` but

tons | Attribute-based selectors, so hashed CSS-module class names don't matter. |
| `dsh-peakrate`
model menu | `.dsh-peakrate-ms-menu`, `.dsh-peakrate-ms-group`, `.dsh-peakrate-ms-option` | Optional
; this plugin never depends on it. |
The rules are scoped so the two-cell root pane (Model / Reasoning effort) of the peakrate menu keeps
its normal narrow width — only the grouped model list is widened.
## Install
This is a DSH **profile plugin**. It is host-only, and the web UI must live at the bundle layer to a
ppear, so it needs to be in `dsh.profile.bundles`.

Then add the same `"dsh-model-grid"` entry to `dsh.profile.bundles` and restart.
> Restarting the profile is required: the host plugin is loaded at boot and the stylesheet is inject
ed when the page is served.
## Configuration
Options are passed through the plugin entry's `config` and merged with the defaults.
| Key | Default | Description |

| `maxWidth` | `900` | Hard cap on the popup width, in CSS px (clamped 240–4000). |
| `minCardWidth`

| `200` | Minimum width of a model card, in CSS px (clamped 80–1200). |
| `gap` | `6` | Gap between

cards, in CSS px (clamped 0–64). |
| `maxHeightVh` | `76` | Popup height cap, in `vh` (clamped 20–1

00). |
| `hideCountdown` | `true` | Hide the long "· 14h 23m" countdown in the price badge. |
| `ena
bled` | `true` | When `false`, nothing is injected. |

## How it works

1. `apply(ctx, config)` listens for the host's `webserver/index-inject` event.
2. On every index res

ponse, the listener pushes one `{ kind: "style", text }` row.
3. DSH renders that row as a `<style>`

pushes one `{ kind: "style", text }` row.
3. DSH renders that row as a `<style>` block in `<head>`.
Because the CSS is generated from `css.js` at injection time, there is no file I/O and nothing to ke
ep in sync. `buildCss()` is exported and unit-tested independently of the host.
## Compatibility

- DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2** (declared in `package.json` → `dsh.compatibility`).
- Node.js **>=

22**.
- No bundler, no client build step.
